on ReOrderQuestions
	local tTable, tRecordID, tTarget, tOutputA,tDataA,tResultA 
	local tRecordsToSync
	put cdb_TableID(authedUserQuestionsTable) into tTable
	put "local" into tTarget 

	// LOAD IN ALL QUESTIONS
	// CREATE BATCH READ REQUEST ARRAY
	repeat with xQuestion = 1 to the number of lines of QuestionsForQuestionsList
		put line xQuestion of QuestionsForQuestionsList into tRecordID
		 put empty into tDataA[tTable][tRecordID]
	end repeat
	
	put cdb_batchRead(tDataA,tTarget) into tOutputA
	put cdb_result()
	// UPDATE ORDER AND COMPILE SYNC AND UPDATE
	repeat with xQuestion = 1 to the number of lines of QuestionsForQuestionsList
		put line xQuestion of QuestionsForQuestionsList into tRecordID
		put xQuestion into tOutputA[tTable][tRecordID]["QuestionOrder"]
	end repeat
	
	put empty into tDataA
	put tOutputA into tDataA
	
	appli_showLoading "Updating Order"
	cdb_batchUpdate tDataA, tTarget
	put cdb_result()
	// SYNC RECORD IN CLOUD
	put cdb_sync(QuestionsForQuestionsList,tTable,"local",false,true) into tResultA
	put cdb_result()
end ReOrderQuestions
